reason: ₹22,000 is more than a month of what my whole house earns, and my wife already washes clothes by hand at no cost. Paying ₹2,000 every month for a year just for washing, I cannot do that, maybe after a good harvest.
objection: Hand-washing is free and we have always done it, so why should I pay so much money and then keep paying EMI on top of the seed and fertiliser loans.
would_change_my_mind: A big Diwali or harvest-season offer that brings the price down to around ₹12,000 with a free gift, from a dealer in the block town I already know.
